extraction.notes: No 2027 VBS information was found. The 2025 True North VBS is an older version of the same program, not a separate card. KidSalt and SummerSalt are held at Charleston Southern University in North Charleston, outside the directory's geographic range, according to their official operator pages: https://www.scbaptist.org/ministries/camps/kidsalt/ and https://www.scbaptist.org/ministries/camps/summersalt/. The VBS event page does not identify its meeting venue; the church footer lists 395 W. Rutherford St., while its homepage refers to worship at Landrum High School, so neither was assumed to be the VBS site.
